title: Duplicated truncate-to-5 list-formatting for the skipped and xfailed violation messages
description: The blocks building the `skipped` and `xfailed` violation strings (lines 72-79 and 80-87) are near-identical: each joins `result.nodeid` over the first 5 entries, appends ", ..." when more than 5 exist, and formats a message. The shared shape (slice [:5], join on nodeid, conditional ellipsis) could be extracted into a small helper such as `_summarise_nodeids(results, limit=5) -> str` to remove the copy-paste and keep the two messages in sync. This is purely a readability/maintenance cleanup; it does not change observable behavior or output.
behavior_preservation: Identical violation strings before and after; only the construction is factored into a shared helper. Covered by tests/test_perf_suite_script.py::test_budget_violations_fail_when_perf_tests_are_skipped_or_xfailed which asserts the exact message text.
